WPSS No.1022 of 2024
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for 
the petitioners.
2. Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, learned 
Additional C.S.C. along with Mr. Bhupendra 
Koranga, learned Brief Holder for the State of 
Uttarakhand/respondent Nos.1, 2 & 4 to 6.
3. Mr. Ashish Joshi, learned counsel for 
respondent No.3, appeared through video 
conferencing.
4. It is contended by learned counsel for the 
petitioners that in the similar set of 
controversy, this Court has passed interim 
order on 13.06.2024 in WPSS No.316 of 2024. 
Since, the controversy involved in the present 
writ petition is identical, interim order can be 
passed in this petition.
5. To this proposition, learned State 
Counsel as well as learned counsel for 
respondent No.3 have not disputed the said 
submission made by the learned counsel for 
the petitioners.
6. List on 24.10.2024. 
7. Till next date of listing, the respondents 
are restrained from interfering in the 
functioning of the petitioners to the post of 
Junior Engineer.
8. In the meantime, respondents may file 
counter affidavit, if any. 
9. Interim relief application (IA/1/2024) 
stands disposed of accordingly.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 20.06.2024
PN

WPSS/1022/2024
Seema & others
--Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand & others
--Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
None present for the petitioners.
2. Mr. Bhupendra Koranga, learned Brief 
Holder for the State.
3. Mr. Pankaj Miglani, learned counsel for the 
respondent no.3-Commission.
4. The matter is being taken up on a mention 
being made on behalf of the respondent￾Commission.
5. It is submitted by learned counsel for the 
Commission that the matter is squarely covered 
by the judgment and order dated 11.06.2025 in 
Special Appeal No.24 of 2025 passed by the 
Division Bench of this Court. He further submits 
that, in this writ petition, an advertisement for 
supplying the vacancy on the post of Junior 
Engineer in the department has been challenged.
6. At the request of learned counsel for the 
Commission, put up this matter on 28.10.2026.
7. Urgency application (IA No.5/2025) stands 
disposed of accordingly.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
06.10.2026 AK
